system.description:
You have an uncanny ability to call upon your reserves when you most need them.

Prerequisite: Constitution 13

Effect: When you catch a Second Wind, you can choose to regain only half of the Hit Points you normally would with a Second Wind and immediately Move up to half of your Speed. This movement does not provoke Attacks of Opportunity.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scum and Villainy
